description: This source file defines a Orleans grain class 'StatelessWorkerWithMayInterleaveGrain' which implements the 'IStatelessWorkerWithMayInterleaveGrain' interface. It is decorated with Orleans attributes to specify stateless worker settings and may-interleave behavior. The class includes methods for waiting asynchronously on a callback, and a static method to determine if a method can interleave based on its name.

classes.name: StatelessWorkerWithMayInterleaveGrain
classes.description: A stateless worker Orleans grain with configurable interleaving behavior, capable of executing 'GoSlow' and 'GoFast' methods with callback coordination.

methods.name: MayInterleaveMethod
methods.description: Static method to determine if a given request can interleave execution based on method name.
